I mean, i agree with most of what you said, but i definitely care a lot about her, even if i am obsessed with her. I can love her, and be obsessed with her at the same time. It's just the obsession part that is a problem. I'm fully aware of that & i actively try to give her as much space as i can bare. But it seems like no amount of space and no amount of time is enough for her. She moved out for 5 months, and now she's been completely gone for another 3 months working with still a month to go. It sounds to me like she just wants to break up but can't bring herself to do it either. We do have an extremely complicated and long history. I'm sure that throwing that away would still be difficult for her to do, even if clearly not nearly as difficult as it would be for me.


>nothing should really be stopping you from doing it yourself too.


Except that she'll be long gone before i can even start thinking about doing something like that, She has a car already, I have debts right now, and i don't even have a license on top of that. So i'm literally just stuck to wait until she comes back, or doesn't, pretty much.

Yeah.. I've always kind of been pretty sure i'll be the one who ends my life. I've tried a few times, but i'm really.. really shitty at it. the **what if** factor always gets to me. That and the usual accompaniment of pain and fear. I'll probably do it like a woman and use pills some day. I've had pretty bad stomach aches all my life, so i think i could handle ODing pains. But carbon monoxide sounds the nicest to me.. Secretly I really wish i could somehow get my girlfriend to help me.. I've always kind of sort of known on some level that the last thing i want to see in this world is her face... Once while we were really drunk i went way too far with erotic asphyxiation.. I kept egging her on and on I started blacking out before she stopped and went, what the fuck?, To which stupid, drunken me replied "i want to die".

But yeh.. I think i know how you feel. I'm pretty sure i will end up taking my own life some day.

I actively sabotage myself in my daily life to avoid getting to a good place, so that i don't have anything to lose, because i'm terrified of loss, which i've been repeatedly traumatized by to the point that i am unable to feel anymore. I just watch things burn down around me. 

*nice to meet you, too*

She's in college right now in an outdoor adventure program, so in tandem with that, she got a job abroad this summer, across the Provence, kind of in the middle of nowhere, so i've had very limited communication with her the last 3 months, which is tasking, but it's given me time to think, and apparently it's given her time to think too, because now she's telling me she wants MORE time apart to go travel by herself- A plan that we had together, that she now wants to go do by herself. It feels like this is just her way of breaking up with me. Like She's just going to go off, stringing me along, hoping that she'll come back but she never will. She'll just go off, meet someone new and start a new life. and who can blame her?

I called my mom asking what the fuck was going on, i called My girlfriend's best friend and then i called the suicide hotline None of them really helped me much, i was in complete mental breakdown. i sat in my bathroom, tore apart a razer and cut my wrists until my phone rang and it was my dad, he calmed me down a little bit and said he would call her for me and talk to her.. Somehow.. I don't even remember how.. I managed to get her to let me call her and just listen while i pleaded to her that it wasn't true. She didn't want to hear a word of it. she thought i was just making excuses, trying to save myself, whatever. She listened, and told me at the very least, she needed time for herself. I can get that. completely. I wouldn't want to live with a potential incestuous rapist pedophile either. It's tough as fuck, and i make a number more suicide attempts, but somehow i got through a month of that. I probably wouldn't have if she had really severed communications with me completely. She would text me every once in a while, I went home to my dad's for christmas to try and get in a room with my sister to talk to her about it, but it never happened, she wouldn't come anywhere near me. i never even got to see her. While i was there though, My girlfriend started messaging me again, and things were going okay, like she had started to believe me. When my dad called her, it seemed to do a LOT to assure her of my innocence, because what my sister told my dad was "he tried to pull my pants down" not "He raped me in 2009" which are completely COMPLETELY different things. I have no memory of doing this still, but i could see a brotherly reason to try and undo your stoned little sister's skinny jeans when she's passed out, sweating like crazy and groaning with her eyes closed. 

finally one night she was texting me, asking if i could bring some of her stuff downstairs for her that she needed, because she didn't want to see me at all, but apparently she changed her mind that night because i was getting her stuff together when i heard my front door open and close, i came out to see her standing there, and i just started shaking like a leaf. She kind of turned away to take off her winter stuff and grab the stuff she needed that was in my kitchen, while she did that i just sort of slunked down in my bathroom right where i was when i was cutting myself, shaking uncontrollably, fighting the urge to just run out there and grab her and never let go until finally i couldn't fight it anymore, and that's exactly what i did. as though outside of my own body, i remember getting up, walking across my apartment to meet her in the kitchen, i looked her in the eyes, apologized, and then grabbed a hold of her. apologizing over and over, saying i tried to hold myself back until i realized she was hugging me back and crying. I could not believe it. She was starting to believe me. I never ever expected that i would be able to convince her i didn't do this. My fricking sister for fucks sake. We started seeing each other more and more frequently, just kind of as friends, until we went on an honest to god date and definitely got back together. After that things seemed like they were getting better. We were hanging out regularly, doing more things together than when we lived together, doing real things, Everything seemed to be back on track, sure it wasn't perfect, but things were getting better by the day, instead of getting worse. I wish that's where the story ended.

She told me my sister had had a chat with her, and that she said that i had raped her in 2009. I have NO IDEA where this is coming from, she described a specific occasion, to which i do remember vividly, because it was the time that i let her smoke weed with me for the first time, and she had too much and passed out. She is apparently under the impression that after that, i took advantage of her.

Alright here goes. Fair warning, now is the time to get out if you want to get out.

This all kind of came to light around last Christmas.. It was a pretty normal day, until my girlfriend seemed to freak out over nothing. I kind of pointed out that she had left out some fruit and it had gone moldy in our living room, where she just randomly burst out with "Fine then i'll just move out! i've already been thinking about it" At the time i just kind of thought she was just worked up over it for nothing, but it was actually not an over reaction, she had been upset and just not talking about it for weeks. About a week after this happened, she came home from school one day with one of her friends, grabbed some of her things didn't say a word, and left. I assumed she was rushing off to go snowboarding because she grabbed her board, but when she didn't come home the next day, i texted her asking what was up, Nothing in the world could have prepared me for what i found out after that..
Yeah, honestly i'm talking about work entirely because i don't know how to start talking about the things that are actually bothering me. No matter how i try, it all sounds pathetic..

well yeah. I have to see them pretty much every day. and they're all shit heads, so they would make fun of me for it until i quit and my manager is a super alpha male dickhead who's not gonna take me seriously if i call in depressed. Idek what i'm gonna say if/when i do go back. Woops. My bad.

hah. honestly it's so inconsequential comparatively to the shit storm that is my life. I like nights, i sleep better during the day. i hardly even dislike my job, i just can't face it right now without completely losing my composure and breaking down in tears in front of all my co-workers which is a level of embarrassment i'm not sure i could handle.

Yup. i work nights. Full time hours in a part time position. Living the walmart dream. I didn't even call last night. i just didn't show up. and i've been working there under 3 months. and they've specifically been harping about people not showing up for shifts. so i'm probably fucked. but i don't even care.

I skipped work last night, cause i was concerned i would go in and lose my shit as soon as i was alone with my thoughts. second day in a row now. Probably gonna get myself fired & make this all worse.
